title: Read, infer and explain
intro: Some answers are stated clearly. For others, use a clue and explain your thinking. Stop before an ending and predict what might happen. More than one prediction can make sense.
support: ځینې ځوابونه په لیکنه کې ښکاره دي. د نورو لپاره نښه پیدا کړئ او خپله خبره تشریح کړئ. تر پای مخکې اټکل وکړئ.
text:
Lina put her book in a bag. Dark clouds filled the sky. She heard a rumble and ran towards home.
Ending: At home she took the dry book out of her bag.
model: A literal answer is on the page. To infer, combine a clue with what you know. To predict, stop before the ending and suggest a next event that fits a clue.
activity: Cover the ending after reading the first three sentences. Write or draw a possible next event and underline a clue.
adult: Say without showing print: “Sam held out a bowl. The dog wagged its tail and ran over.” Ask what Sam held and why the dog might come. Ask which words helped.

tasks: Say where Lina put the book. Point to the words that tell you.
List two things Lina notices before she runs.
Cover the ending. Predict what may happen next. Give a clue.
Say why Lina might run. Tell which event supports your idea.
Explain which event could happen in your life. Make up one imaginary change.
Have an adult read a short passage. Answer one spoken question about it.
Write two list entries about the story. Read your notes to a partner.
Read: Lina hangs her wet coat by the door. She puts her dry book on a chair. What does she put on the chair? Write two facts from the text.
Read: Omar left wet shoes by the door. There were puddles on the path. His socks were dry. Where might Omar have walked? Explain with a clue.
Read: Sara has a dry towel. Her dog comes in wet and shakes by the door. Stop here. Predict what Sara might do. Give a clue.
